reviews.title: Great game
reviews.text: While you need to buy the subscription to actually enjoy the game, 20 bucks a year is quite affordable. I went from struggling to do 15 push ups in a row on day 1 to now doing 30+ in a row easy on day 10. I’ve always found it hard to discipline myself but it’s been easier with this app. I’ve never been one to pay for apps but this is worth every penny.

reviews.title: Paywall with pretty much zero content
reviews.text: I could understand a subscription with benefits included for things that aren’t the whole point of the app. The fact that you can’t “fight” anything besides a goblin/training dummy if you don’t shell out 7 bucks a month is pitiful. Don’t waste your time with this app, the idea seemed exciting, but a paywall on everything besides a training dummy and goblin is insane. Also the tracking is TERRIBLE! What’s mind boggling is the audacity to have a “free” app be 95% paywalled when the tracking itself which records your push ups is completely trash! Just throw the whole app away and start over.
